title: 建築環境設計Ⅰ
subtitle: Environmental Design for Architecture I
keywords: Zero-energy building 2.Green building 3.Environmental design 4.Air conditioning design
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn about current conditions and methods for realizing zero-energy buildings. (2) learn about current conditions and methods for realizing green buildings. (3) learn about calculation of heat load and cooling coil capability.
advice: In order to realize healthy and comfortable indoor environments that consume little energy, students learn about the thermal performance of buildings and the newest equipment that should be chosen in planning and design. 1. Net-zero energy buildings 2. Environmental performance of green buildings 3. Buildings’ thermal performance and labelling indexes 4. Cool-biz air conditioning systems
requiredKnowledge: Students need credits from Introduction of Building Equipment, Architectural Environment I and II, and Building Equipment.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the meaning of terms related to zero-energy buildings.
Students can explain the meaning of terms related to green buildings.
Students can explain thermal performance and the newest equipment for next-generation buildings.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
